````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import {
  3:   useState,
  4:   useMemo,
  5:   useRef,
  6:   useCallback,
  7:   useEffect,
  8:   type ChangeEvent,
  9: } from "react";
 10: import { updateLessonContentAction } from "@/actions/lesson-content";
 11: import { normalizeVideoUrl } from "@/lib/video";
 12: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
 13: import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
 14: import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
 15: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 16: import {
 17:   Loader2,
 18:   CheckCircle2,
 19:   AlertCircle,
 20:   Plus,
 21:   Trash2,
 22:   ExternalLink,
 23:   Eye,
 24:   Edit3,
 25: } from "lucide-react";
 26: import type { LessonContent } from "@prisma/client";
 27: export interface ResourceItem {
 28:   name: string;
 29:   url: string;
 30: }
 31: interface EditorResourceItem extends ResourceItem {
 32:   id: string;
 33: }
 34: function createResourceId(): string {
 35:   if (
 36:     typeof crypto !== "undefined" &&
 37:     typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
 38:   ) {
 39:     return crypto.randomUUID();
 40:   }
 41:   return `res-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 11)}-${Date.now()}`;
 42: }
 43: const serializeResources = (items: EditorResourceItem[]): ResourceItem[] =>
 44:   items.map(({ name, url }) => ({ name, url }));
 45: export interface LessonContentEditorProps {
 46:   lessonId: string;
 47:   initialData?: {
 48:     bodyMarkdown?: string | null;
 49:     bodyHtml?: string | null;
 50:     videoUrl?: string | null;
 51:     resources?: ResourceItem[] | null;
 52:   };
 53:   readOnly?: boolean;
 54:   onSaveSuccess?: (data: LessonContent) => void;
 55: }
 56: type SaveStatus = "saved" | "saving" | "unsaved" | "error";
 57: export function LessonContentEditor({
 58:   lessonId,
 59:   initialData,
 60:   readOnly = false,
 61:   onSaveSuccess,
 62: }: LessonContentEditorProps) {
 63:   const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<"write" | "preview">("write");
 64:   const [bodyMarkdown, setBodyMarkdown] = useState(
 65:     initialData?.bodyMarkdown ?? "",
 66:   );
 67:   const [previewHtml, setPreviewHtml] = useState(initialData?.bodyHtml ?? "");
 68:   const [videoUrlInput, setVideoUrlInput] = useState(
 69:     initialData?.videoUrl ?? "",
 70:   );
 71:   const [resources, setResources] = useState<EditorResourceItem[]>(() =>
 72:     (initialData?.resources ?? []).map((res) => ({
 73:       ...res,
 74:       id: createResourceId(),
 75:     })),
 76:   );
 77:   const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState<SaveStatus>("saved");
 78:   const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
 79:   const videoEmbedUrl = useMemo(() => {
 80:     if (!videoUrlInput.trim()) return "";
 81:     try {
 82:       return normalizeVideoUrl(videoUrlInput);
 83:     } catch {
 84:       return null;
 85:     }
 86:   }, [videoUrlInput]);
 87:   // Sequential Autosave Queue refs
 88:   const sequenceRef = useRef(0);
 89:   const isSavingRef = useRef(false);
 90:   const pendingPayloadRef = useRef<{
 91:     lessonId: string;
 92:     bodyMarkdown: string;
 93:     videoUrl: string;
 94:     resources: ResourceItem[];
 95:   } | null>(null);
 96:   const executeSave = useCallback(
 97:     async (initialPayload: {
 98:       lessonId: string;
 99:       bodyMarkdown: string;
100:       videoUrl: string;
101:       resources: ResourceItem[];
102:     }) => {
103:       isSavingRef.current = true;
104:       setSaveStatus("saving");
105:       setErrorMessage(null);
106:       let currentPayload: typeof initialPayload | null = initialPayload;
107:       while (currentPayload) {
108:         const payload = currentPayload;
109:         currentPayload = null;
110:         pendingPayloadRef.current = null;
111:         const currentSeq = ++sequenceRef.current;
112:         try {
113:           const result = await updateLessonContentAction({
114:             lessonId: payload.lessonId,
115:             bodyMarkdown: payload.bodyMarkdown,
116:             videoUrl: payload.videoUrl,
117:             resources: payload.resources,
118:           });
119:           if (currentSeq === sequenceRef.current) {
120:             if (result.success) {
121:               setSaveStatus("saved");
122:               if (result.data.bodyHtml) {
123:                 setPreviewHtml(result.data.bodyHtml);
124:               }
125:               onSaveSuccess?.(result.data);
126:             } else {
127:               setSaveStatus("error");
128:               setErrorMessage(result.error || "Failed to save lesson content.");
129:             }
130:           }
131:         } catch {
132:           if (currentSeq === sequenceRef.current) {
133:             setSaveStatus("error");
134:             setErrorMessage("Network error while saving.");
135:           }
136:         }
137:         if (pendingPayloadRef.current) {
138:           currentPayload = pendingPayloadRef.current;
139:           pendingPayloadRef.current = null;
140:         }
141:       }
142:       isSavingRef.current = false;
143:     },
144:     [onSaveSuccess],
145:   );
146:   const requestSave = useCallback(
147:     (payload: {
148:       lessonId: string;
149:       bodyMarkdown: string;
150:       videoUrl: string;
151:       resources: ResourceItem[];
152:     }) => {
153:       if (readOnly) return;
154:       setSaveStatus("unsaved");
155:       if (isSavingRef.current) {
156:         pendingPayloadRef.current = payload;
157:       } else {
158:         void executeSave(payload);
159:       }
160:     },
161:     [executeSave, readOnly],
162:   );
163:   const debounceTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
164:   const triggerDebouncedSave = useCallback(() => {
165:     if (readOnly) return;
166:     setSaveStatus("unsaved");
167:     if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
168:       clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
169:     }
170:     debounceTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
171:       requestSave({
172:         lessonId,
173:         bodyMarkdown,
174:         videoUrl: videoUrlInput,
175:         resources: serializeResources(resources),
176:       });
177:     }, 1200);
178:   }, [bodyMarkdown, lessonId, readOnly, requestSave, resources, videoUrlInput]);
179:   useEffect(() => {
180:     return () => {
181:       if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
182:         clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
183:       }
184:     };
185:   }, []);
186:   const handleMarkdownChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
187:     setBodyMarkdown(e.target.value);
188:     triggerDebouncedSave();
189:   };
190:   const handleVideoUrlChange = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
191:     setVideoUrlInput(e.target.value);
192:     triggerDebouncedSave();
193:   };
194:   const handleAddResource = () => {
195:     if (resources.length >= 10 || readOnly) return;
196:     const updated: EditorResourceItem[] = [
197:       ...resources,
198:       { id: createResourceId(), name: "", url: "" },
199:     ];
200:     setResources(updated);
201:     triggerDebouncedSave();
202:   };
203:   const handleUpdateResource = (
204:     id: string,
205:     field: "name" | "url",
206:     value: string,
207:   ) => {
208:     if (readOnly) return;
209:     const updated = resources.map((res) =>
210:       res.id === id ? { ...res, [field]: value } : res,
211:     );
212:     setResources(updated);
213:     triggerDebouncedSave();
214:   };
215:   const handleRemoveResource = (id: string) => {
216:     if (readOnly) return;
217:     const updated = resources.filter((res) => res.id !== id);
218:     setResources(updated);
219:     triggerDebouncedSave();
220:   };
221:   const handleManualSave = () => {
222:     if (readOnly) return;
223:     if (debounceTimerRef.current) {
224:       clearTimeout(debounceTimerRef.current);
225:     }
226:     requestSave({
227:       lessonId,
228:       bodyMarkdown,
229:       videoUrl: videoUrlInput,
230:       resources: serializeResources(resources),
231:     });
232:   };
233:   return (
234:     <div className="space-y-6">
235:       {}
236:       <div className="border-border/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-4">
237:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
238:           {}
239:           <div className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground inline-flex rounded-lg p-1">
240:             <button
241:               type="button"
242:               onClick={() => setActiveTab("write")}
243:               className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
244:                 activeTab === "write"
245:                   ? "bg-background text-foreground shadow-sm"
246:                   : "hover:text-foreground"
247:               }`}
248:             >
249:               <Edit3 className="size-3.5" />
250:               Write
251:             </button>
252:             <button
253:               type="button"
254:               onClick={() => setActiveTab("preview")}
255:               className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-all ${
256:                 activeTab === "preview"
257:                   ? "bg-background text-foreground shadow-sm"
258:                   : "hover:text-foreground"
259:               }`}
260:             >
261:               <Eye className="size-3.5" />
262:               Preview
263:             </button>
264:           </div>
265:         </div>
266:         {}
267:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
268:           <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
269:             {saveStatus === "saving" && (
270:               <>
271:                 <Loader2 className="text-muted-foreground size-3.5 animate-spin" />
272:                 <span className="text-muted-foreground">Saving...</span>
273:               </>
274:             )}
275:             {saveStatus === "saved" && (
276:               <>
277:                 <CheckCircle2 className="size-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
278:                 <span className="text-muted-foreground">Saved</span>
279:               </>
280:             )}
281:             {saveStatus === "unsaved" && (
282:               <>
283:                 <span className="size-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
284:                 <span className="text-muted-foreground">Unsaved changes</span>
285:               </>
286:             )}
287:             {saveStatus === "error" && (
288:               <>

290:                 <span className="text-destructive font-medium">

293:               </>
294:             )}
295:           </div>
296:           {!readOnly && (

299:               variant="outline"
300:               size="sm"
301:               onClick={handleManualSave}
302:               disabled={saveStatus === "saving"}

308:         </div>
````

## File: src/components/features/enrollment/enrollment-button.tsx
````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: import { useState } from "react";
 3: import { enrollInCourseAction } from "@/actions/enrollment";
 4: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 5: import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
 6: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
 7: export interface EnrollmentButtonProps {
 8:   courseId: string;
 9:   initialIsEnrolled?: boolean;
10:   onEnrollSuccess?: () => void;
11:   className?: string;
12: }
13: export function EnrollmentButton({
14:   courseId,
15:   initialIsEnrolled = false,
16:   onEnrollSuccess,
17:   className,
18: }: EnrollmentButtonProps) {
19:   const [isEnrolled, setIsEnrolled] = useState(initialIsEnrolled);
20:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
21:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
22:   const handleEnroll = async () => {
23:     if (isEnrolled || isLoading) return;
24:     setIsLoading(true);
25:     setError(null);
26:     try {
27:       const result = await enrollInCourseAction({ courseId });
28:       if (!result.success) {
29:         setError(result.error);
30:         gooeyToast.error(result.error);
31:         return;
32:       }
33:       setIsEnrolled(true);
34:       gooeyToast.success("Successfully enrolled in course!");
35:       onEnrollSuccess?.();
36:     } catch {
37:       const message = "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.";
38:       setError(message);
39:       gooeyToast.error(message);
40:     } finally {
41:       setIsLoading(false);
42:     }
43:   };
44:   if (isEnrolled) {
45:     return (
46:       <Button
47:         type="button"
48:         variant="outline"
49:         disabled
50:         className={`border-primary/20 bg-primary/5 text-primary min-h-10 min-w-10 cursor-default gap-2 opacity-100 ${
51:           className ?? ""
52:         }`}
53:         aria-label="Already enrolled in this course"
54:       >
55:         <Check className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
56:         <span>Enrolled</span>
57:       </Button>
58:     );
59:   }
60:   return (
61:     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
62:       <Button
63:         type="button"
64:         onClick={handleEnroll}
65:         disabled={isLoading}
66:         className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 gap-2 transition-transform active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none ${
67:           className ?? ""
68:         }`}
69:         aria-label="Enroll in course"
70:       >
71:         {isLoading ? (
72:           <>
73:             <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
74:             <span>Enrolling...</span>
75:           </>
76:         ) : (
77:           <span>Enroll Now</span>
78:         )}
79:       </Button>
80:       {error && (
81:         <p className="text-destructive text-xs" role="alert">
82:           {error}
83:         </p>
84:       )}
85:     </div>
86:   );
87: }
````

````typescript
  9: interface CourseDangerZoneProps {

 14: export function CourseDangerZone({
 15:   courseId,

 17:   status,
 18: }: CourseDangerZoneProps) {
 19:   const router = useRouter();
 20:   const [isArchiving, setIsArchiving] = React.useState(false);
 21:   const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = React.useState(false);
 22:   const handleArchive = async () => {
 23:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
 24:       `Are you sure you want to archive "${courseTitle}"? Students will no longer be able to enroll, and current students will lose access to new updates.`,
 25:     );
 26:     if (!confirmed) return;
 27:     setIsArchiving(true);
 28:     try {
 29:       const result = await archiveCourseAction(courseId);
 30:       if (result.success) {
 31:         gooeyToast.success("Course archived successfully.");
 32:         router.refresh();
 33:       } else {
 34:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to archive course.");
 35:       }
 36:     } catch {
 37:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to archive course. Please try again.");
 38:     } finally {
 39:       setIsArchiving(false);
 40:     }
 41:   };
 42:   const handleDelete = async () => {
 43:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
 44:       `Are you sure you want to permanently delete "${courseTitle}"? This will delete all modules, lessons, and student progress records. This action CANNOT be undone.`,
 45:     );
 46:     if (!confirmed) return;
 47:     setIsDeleting(true);
 48:     try {
 49:       const result = await deleteCourseAction(courseId);
 50:       if (result.success) {
 51:         gooeyToast.success("Course deleted successfully.");
 52:         router.push("/instructor/courses");
 53:       } else {
 54:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to delete course.");
 55:       }
 56:     } catch {
 57:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to delete course. Please try again.");
 58:     } finally {
 59:       setIsDeleting(false);
 60:     }
 61:   };
 62:   const isArchived = status === CourseStatus.ARCHIVED;
 63:   return (
 64:     <div className="border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 rounded-xl border p-6 shadow-xs">
 65:       <div className="text-destructive flex items-center gap-2.5">
 66:         <AlertTriangle className="size-5" />
 67:         <h3 className="text-base font-semibold">Danger Zone</h3>
 68:       </div>
 69:       <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 max-w-[65ch] text-xs">
 70:         These actions are destructive. Please proceed with caution.
 71:       </p>
 72:       <div className="divide-destructive/10 mt-6 flex flex-col gap-4 divide-y">
 73:         {}
 74:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pt-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
 75:           <div>
 76:             <h4 className="text-foreground text-sm font-medium">
 77:               Archive this course
 78:             </h4>
 79:             <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
 80:               {isArchived
 81:                 ? "This course is currently archived."
 82:                 : "Remove course from public view while preserving student records."}
 83:             </p>
 84:           </div>
 85:           <Button
 86:             variant="outline"
 87:             size="sm"
 88:             disabled={isArchiving || isArchived}
 89:             onClick={handleArchive}
 90:             className="border-destructive/30 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 min-h-10 min-w-10 active:scale-[0.98]"
 91:           >
 92:             {isArchiving ? (
 93:               <Loader2 className="mr-2 size-4 animate-spin" />
 94:             ) : (
 95:               <Archive className="mr-2 size-4" />
 96:             )}
 97:             {isArchived ? "Archived" : "Archive Course"}
 98:           </Button>
 99:         </div>
100:         {}
101:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pt-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
102:           <div>
103:             <h4 className="text-foreground text-sm font-medium">
104:               Delete this course
105:             </h4>
106:             <p className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">
107:               Permanently remove this course and all its modules and lessons.
108:             </p>
109:           </div>
110:           <Button
111:             variant="destructive"
112:             size="sm"
113:             disabled={isDeleting}
114:             onClick={handleDelete}
115:             className="min-h-10 min-w-10 active:scale-[0.98]"
116:           >
117:             {isDeleting ? (
118:               <Loader2 className="mr-2 size-4 animate-spin" />
119:             ) : (
120:               <Trash2 className="mr-2 size-4" />
121:             )}
122:             Delete Course
123:           </Button>
124:         </div>
125:       </div>
126:     </div>
127:   );
128: }
````

````typescript
 11:   Check,
 12:   X,
 13:   FileText,
 14:   Eye,
 15:   EyeOff,
 16:   Layers,
 17:   Loader2,
 18:   Lock,
 19: } from "lucide-react";
 20: import { CourseStatus } from "@prisma/client";
 21: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
 22: import {
 23:   createModuleAction,
 24:   updateModuleAction,
 25:   deleteModuleAction,
 26:   reorderModulesAction,
 27:   createLessonAction,
 28:   updateLessonAction,
 29:   deleteLessonAction,
 30:   reorderLessonsAction,
 31: } from "@/actions/curriculum";
 32: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 33: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
 34: interface LessonItem {
 35:   id: string;
 36:   title: string;
 37:   slug: string;
 38:   orderIndex: number;
 39:   durationMinutes: number | null;
 40:   isFreePreview: boolean;
 41:   moduleId: string;
 42: }
 43: export interface ModuleItem {
 44:   id: string;
 45:   title: string;
 46:   description: string | null;
 47:   orderIndex: number;
 48:   courseId: string;
 49:   lessons: LessonItem[];
 50: }
 51: interface CurriculumBuilderProps {
 52:   courseId: string;
 53:   courseStatus: CourseStatus;
 54:   initialModules: ModuleItem[];
 55: }
 56: export function CurriculumBuilder({
 57:   courseId,
 58:   courseStatus,
 59:   initialModules,
 60: }: CurriculumBuilderProps) {
 61:   const router = useRouter();
 62:   const [modules, setModules] = React.useState<ModuleItem[]>(initialModules);
 63:   const isPublished = courseStatus === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED;
 64:   const isArchived = courseStatus === CourseStatus.ARCHIVED;
 65:   React.useEffect(() => {
 66:     setModules(initialModules);
 67:   }, [initialModules]);
 68:   const [editingModuleId, setEditingModuleId] = React.useState<string | null>(
 69:     null,
 70:   );
 71:   const [editingModuleTitle, setEditingModuleTitle] = React.useState("");
 72:   // Inline editing state for lessons
 73:   const [editingLessonId, setEditingLessonId] = React.useState<string | null>(
 74:     null,
 75:   );
 76:   const [editingLessonTitle, setEditingLessonTitle] = React.useState("");
 77:   // New module creation state
 78:   const [isAddingModule, setIsAddingModule] = React.useState(false);
 79:   const [newModuleTitle, setNewModuleTitle] = React.useState("");
 80:   const [isSubmittingModule, setIsSubmittingModule] = React.useState(false);
 81:   // New lesson creation state per module: map moduleId -> string (title)
 82:   const [addingLessonForModuleId, setAddingLessonForModuleId] = React.useState<
 83:     string | null
 84:   >(null);
 85:   const [newLessonTitle, setNewLessonTitle] = React.useState("");
 86:   const [isSubmittingLesson, setIsSubmittingLesson] = React.useState(false);
 87:   // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 88:   // Module Actions
 89:   // ──────────────────────────────────────────────
 90:   const handleCreateModule = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
 91:     e.preventDefault();
 92:     if (!newModuleTitle.trim()) return;
 93:     setIsSubmittingModule(true);
 94:     try {
 95:       const result = await createModuleAction({
 96:         courseId,
 97:         title: newModuleTitle.trim(),
 98:       });
 99:       if (result.success) {
100:         gooeyToast.success("Module created.");
101:         setModules((prev) => [
102:           ...prev,
103:           {
104:             ...result.data,
105:             lessons: [],
106:           },
107:         ]);
108:         setNewModuleTitle("");
109:         setIsAddingModule(false);
110:         router.refresh();
111:       } else {
112:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to create module.");
113:       }
114:     } catch {
115:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to create module. Please try again.");
116:     } finally {
117:       setIsSubmittingModule(false);
118:     }
119:   };
120:   const handleSaveModuleTitle = async (moduleId: string) => {
121:     if (!editingModuleTitle.trim()) {
122:       setEditingModuleId(null);
123:       return;
124:     }
125:     const previousTitle = modules.find((m) => m.id === moduleId)?.title;
126:     // Optimistic update
127:     setModules((prev) =>
128:       prev.map((m) =>
129:         m.id === moduleId ? { ...m, title: editingModuleTitle.trim() } : m,
130:       ),
131:     );
132:     setEditingModuleId(null);
133:     try {
134:       const result = await updateModuleAction(moduleId, {
135:         title: editingModuleTitle.trim(),
136:       });
137:       if (result.success) {
138:         gooeyToast.success("Module updated.");
139:       } else {
140:         // Rollback
141:         setModules((prev) =>
142:           prev.map((m) =>
143:             m.id === moduleId ? { ...m, title: previousTitle ?? m.title } : m,
144:           ),
145:         );
146:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to update module.");
147:       }
148:     } catch {
149:       // Rollback
150:       setModules((prev) =>
151:         prev.map((m) =>
152:           m.id === moduleId ? { ...m, title: previousTitle ?? m.title } : m,
153:         ),
154:       );
155:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to update module.");
156:     }
157:   };
158:   const handleDeleteModule = async (moduleId: string, title: string) => {
159:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
160:       `Are you sure you want to delete module "${title}" and all its lessons?`,
161:     );
162:     if (!confirmed) return;
163:     const previousModules = [...modules];
164:     setModules((prev) => prev.filter((m) => m.id !== moduleId));
165:     try {
166:       const result = await deleteModuleAction(moduleId);
167:       if (result.success) {
168:         gooeyToast.success("Module deleted.");
169:         router.refresh();
170:       } else {
171:         setModules(previousModules);
172:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to delete module.");
173:       }
174:     } catch {
175:       setModules(previousModules);
176:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to delete module.");
177:     }
178:   };
179:   const handleMoveModule = async (index: number, direction: "up" | "down") => {
180:     const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
181:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= modules.length) return;
182:     const reordered = [...modules];
183:     const [moved] = reordered.splice(index, 1);
184:     reordered.splice(targetIndex, 0, moved);
185:     const updated = reordered.map((m, idx) => ({ ...m, orderIndex: idx }));
186:     const previousModules = [...modules];
187:     setModules(updated);
188:     try {
189:       const result = await reorderModulesAction({
190:         courseId,
191:         orderedIds: updated.map((m) => m.id),
192:       });
193:       if (result.success) {
194:         gooeyToast.success("Modules reordered.");
195:       } else {
196:         setModules(previousModules);
197:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to reorder modules.");
198:       }
199:     } catch {
200:       setModules(previousModules);
201:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to reorder modules.");
202:     }
203:   };
204:   const handleCreateLesson = async (e: React.FormEvent, moduleId: string) => {
205:     e.preventDefault();
206:     if (!newLessonTitle.trim()) return;
207:     setIsSubmittingLesson(true);
208:     try {
209:       const result = await createLessonAction({
210:         moduleId,
211:         title: newLessonTitle.trim(),
212:       });
213:       if (result.success) {
214:         gooeyToast.success("Lesson created.");
215:         setModules((prev) =>
216:           prev.map((mod) => {
217:             if (mod.id === moduleId) {
218:               return {
219:                 ...mod,
220:                 lessons: [...mod.lessons, result.data],
221:               };
222:             }
223:             return mod;
224:           }),
225:         );
226:         setNewLessonTitle("");
227:         setAddingLessonForModuleId(null);
228:         router.refresh();
229:       } else {
230:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to create lesson.");
231:       }
232:     } catch {
233:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to create lesson. Please try again.");
234:     } finally {
235:       setIsSubmittingLesson(false);
236:     }
237:   };
238:   const handleSaveLessonTitle = async (moduleId: string, lessonId: string) => {
239:     if (!editingLessonTitle.trim()) {
240:       setEditingLessonId(null);
241:       return;
242:     }
243:     const previousModules = [...modules];
244:     setModules((prev) =>
245:       prev.map((mod) => {
246:         if (mod.id === moduleId) {
247:           return {
248:             ...mod,
249:             lessons: mod.lessons.map((l) =>
250:               l.id === lessonId
251:                 ? { ...l, title: editingLessonTitle.trim() }
252:                 : l,
253:             ),
254:           };
255:         }
256:         return mod;
257:       }),
258:     );
259:     setEditingLessonId(null);
260:     try {
261:       const result = await updateLessonAction(lessonId, {
262:         title: editingLessonTitle.trim(),
263:       });
264:       if (result.success) {
265:         gooeyToast.success("Lesson updated.");
266:       } else {
267:         setModules(previousModules);
268:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to update lesson.");
269:       }
270:     } catch {
271:       setModules(previousModules);
272:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to update lesson.");
273:     }
274:   };
275:   const handleToggleFreePreview = async (
276:     moduleId: string,
277:     lessonId: string,
278:     currentPreview: boolean,
279:   ) => {
280:     const previousModules = [...modules];
281:     setModules((prev) =>
282:       prev.map((mod) => {
283:         if (mod.id === moduleId) {
284:           return {
285:             ...mod,
286:             lessons: mod.lessons.map((l) =>
287:               l.id === lessonId ? { ...l, isFreePreview: !currentPreview } : l,
288:             ),
289:           };
290:         }
291:         return mod;
292:       }),
293:     );
294:     try {
295:       const result = await updateLessonAction(lessonId, {
296:         isFreePreview: !currentPreview,
297:       });
298:       if (result.success) {
299:         gooeyToast.success(
300:           !currentPreview
301:             ? "Lesson marked as Free Preview."
302:             : "Free preview removed from lesson.",
303:         );
304:       } else {
305:         setModules(previousModules);
306:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to update preview status.");
307:       }
308:     } catch {
309:       setModules(previousModules);
310:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to update preview status.");
311:     }
312:   };
313:   const handleDeleteLesson = async (
314:     moduleId: string,
315:     lessonId: string,
316:     title: string,
317:   ) => {
318:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
319:       `Are you sure you want to delete lesson "${title}"?`,
320:     );
321:     if (!confirmed) return;
322:     const previousModules = [...modules];
323:     setModules((prev) =>
324:       prev.map((mod) => {
325:         if (mod.id === moduleId) {
326:           return {
327:             ...mod,
328:             lessons: mod.lessons.filter((l) => l.id !== lessonId),
329:           };
330:         }
331:         return mod;
332:       }),
333:     );
334:     try {
335:       const result = await deleteLessonAction(lessonId);
336:       if (result.success) {
337:         gooeyToast.success("Lesson deleted.");
338:         router.refresh();
339:       } else {
340:         setModules(previousModules);
341:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to delete lesson.");
342:       }
343:     } catch {
344:       setModules(previousModules);
345:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to delete lesson.");
346:     }
347:   };
348:   const handleMoveLesson = async (
349:     moduleId: string,
350:     index: number,
351:     direction: "up" | "down",
352:   ) => {
353:     const currentModule = modules.find((m) => m.id === moduleId);
354:     if (!currentModule) return;
355:     const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
356:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= currentModule.lessons.length) return;
357:     const reordered = [...currentModule.lessons];
358:     const [moved] = reordered.splice(index, 1);
359:     reordered.splice(targetIndex, 0, moved);
360:     const updatedLessons = reordered.map((l, idx) => ({
361:       ...l,
362:       orderIndex: idx,
363:     }));
364:     const previousModules = [...modules];
365:     setModules((prev) =>
366:       prev.map((m) =>
367:         m.id === moduleId ? { ...m, lessons: updatedLessons } : m,
368:       ),
369:     );
370:     try {
371:       const result = await reorderLessonsAction({
372:         moduleId,
373:         orderedIds: updatedLessons.map((l) => l.id),
374:       });
375:       if (result.success) {
376:         gooeyToast.success("Lessons reordered.");
377:       } else {
378:         setModules(previousModules);
379:         gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to reorder lessons.");
380:       }
381:     } catch {
382:       setModules(previousModules);
383:       gooeyToast.error("Failed to reorder lessons.");
384:     }
385:   };
386:   return (
387:     <div className="space-y-6">
388:       {}
389:       {isPublished && (
390:         <section
391:           aria-label="Course publication status notice"
392:           className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 p-4 text-sm text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-300"
393:         >
394:           <Lock className="mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
395:           <div className="max-w-[65ch] text-pretty">
396:             <p className="font-semibold">Course is Published</p>
397:             <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400/90">
398:               Structural modifications (adding, deleting, or reordering modules
399:               and lessons) are locked while a course is live. To change the
400:               structure, unpublish the course first. You can still update lesson
401:               content directly anytime.
402:             </p>
403:           </div>
404:         </section>
405:       )}
406:       {}
407:       {modules.length === 0 ? (
408:         <div className="border-border bg-card/30 flex min-h-75 flex-col items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-dashed p-8 text-center">
409:           <div className="bg-primary/10 text-primary mb-3 flex size-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl">
410:             <Layers className="size-6" />
411:           </div>
412:           <h3 className="text-foreground text-base font-semibold">
413:             No curriculum items yet
414:           </h3>
415:           <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 max-w-[45ch] text-xs text-pretty">
416:             Begin structuring your course by creating your first module. Modules
417:             group related lessons together.
418:           </p>
419:         </div>
420:       ) : (
421:         <div className="space-y-4">
422:           {modules.map((module, modIndex) => (
423:             <div
424:               key={module.id}
425:               className="border-border bg-card overflow-hidden rounded-xl border shadow-xs transition-all"
426:             >
427:               {}
428:               <div className="border-border/70 bg-muted/40 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b px-4 py-3 sm:px-5">
429:                 <div className="flex min-w-50 flex-1 items-center gap-3">
430:                   {}
431:                   <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
432:                     <button
433:                       type="button"
434:                       aria-label="Move module up"
435:                       disabled={isPublished || isArchived || modIndex === 0}
436:                       onClick={() => handleMoveModule(modIndex, "up")}
437:                       className="border-input text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground flex size-9 min-h-9 min-w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md border active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-30 sm:size-8 sm:min-h-8 sm:min-w-8"
438:                     >
439:                       <ChevronUp className="size-4" />
440:                     </button>
441:                     <button
442:                       type="button"
443:                       aria-label="Move module down"
444:                       disabled={
445:                         isPublished ||
446:                         isArchived ||
447:                         modIndex === modules.length - 1
448:                       }
449:                       onClick={() => handleMoveModule(modIndex, "down")}
450:                       className="border-input text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground flex size-9 min-h-9 min-w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-md border active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-30 sm:size-8 sm:min-h-8 sm:min-w-8"
451:                     >
452:                       <ChevronDown className="size-4" />
453:                     </button>
454:                   </div>
455:                   <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase">
456:                     Module {modIndex + 1}
457:                   </span>
458:                   {}
459:                   {editingModuleId === module.id ? (
460:                     <div className="flex max-w-md flex-1 items-center gap-2">
461:                       <Input
462:                         value={editingModuleTitle}
463:                         onChange={(e) => setEditingModuleTitle(e.target.value)}
464:                         onKeyDown={(e) => {
465:                           if (e.key === "Enter")
466:                             handleSaveModuleTitle(module.id);
467:                           if (e.key === "Escape") setEditingModuleId(null);
468:                         }}
469:                         autoFocus
470:                         className="h-8 text-sm"
471:                       />
472:                       <button
473:                         type="button"
474:                         onClick={() => handleSaveModuleTitle(module.id)}
475:                         className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md"
476:                       >
477:                         <Check className="size-4" />
478:                       </button>
479:                       <button
480:                         type="button"
481:                         onClick={() => setEditingModuleId(null)}
482:                         className="border-input hover:bg-muted text-muted-foreground flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border"
483:                       >
484:                         <X className="size-4" />
485:                       </button>
486:                     </div>
487:                   ) : (
488:                     <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2">
489:                       <h3 className="text-foreground text-sm font-semibold">
490:                         {module.title}
491:                       </h3>
492:                       {!isPublished && !isArchived && (
493:                         <button
494:                           type="button"
495:                           aria-label={`Rename module ${module.title}`}
496:                           onClick={() => {
497:                             setEditingModuleId(module.id);
498:                             setEditingModuleTitle(module.title);
499:                           }}
500:                           className="text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded"
501:                         >
502:                           <Edit2 className="size-3.5" />
503:                         </button>
504:                       )}
505:                     </div>
506:                   )}
507:                 </div>
508:                 {}
509:                 {!isPublished && !isArchived && (
510:                   <Button
511:                     variant="ghost"
512:                     size="icon-sm"
513:                     aria-label={`Delete module ${module.title}`}
514:                     onClick={() => handleDeleteModule(module.id, module.title)}
515:                     className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10 size-8 active:scale-[0.98]"
516:                   >
517:                     <Trash2 className="size-3.5" />
518:                   </Button>
519:                 )}
520:               </div>
521:               {}
522:               <div className="divide-border/40 divide-y p-2 sm:p-3">
523:                 {module.lessons.length === 0 ? (
524:                   <p className="text-muted-foreground py-4 text-center text-xs">
525:                     No lessons in this module yet.
526:                   </p>
527:                 ) : (
528:                   module.lessons.map((lesson, lessonIndex) => (
529:                     <div
530:                       key={lesson.id}
531:                       className="hover:bg-muted/30 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 transition-colors"
532:                     >
533:                       <div className="flex min-w-50 flex-1 items-center gap-3">
534:                         {}
535:                         <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
536:                           <button
537:                             type="button"
538:                             aria-label="Move lesson up"
539:                             disabled={
540:                               isPublished || isArchived || lessonIndex === 0
541:                             }
542:                             onClick={() =>
543:                               handleMoveLesson(module.id, lessonIndex, "up")
544:                             }
545:                             className="border-input text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground flex size-8 min-h-8 min-w-8 items-center justify-center rounded border active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-30"
546:                           >
547:                             <ChevronUp className="size-3.5" />
548:                           </button>
549:                           <button
550:                             type="button"
551:                             aria-label="Move lesson down"
552:                             disabled={
553:                               isPublished ||
554:                               isArchived ||
555:                               lessonIndex === module.lessons.length - 1
556:                             }
557:                             onClick={() =>
558:                               handleMoveLesson(module.id, lessonIndex, "down")
559:                             }
560:                             className="border-input text-muted-foreground hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground flex size-8 min-h-8 min-w-8 items-center justify-center rounded border active:scale-[0.98] disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-30"
561:                           >
562:                             <ChevronDown className="size-3.5" />
563:                           </button>
564:                         </div>
565:                         <span className="text-muted-foreground font-mono text-xs">
566:                           {modIndex + 1}.{lessonIndex + 1}
567:                         </span>
568:                         {}
569:                         {editingLessonId === lesson.id ? (
570:                           <div className="flex max-w-sm flex-1 items-center gap-2">
571:                             <Input
572:                               value={editingLessonTitle}
573:                               onChange={(e) =>
574:                                 setEditingLessonTitle(e.target.value)
575:                               }
576:                               onKeyDown={(e) => {
577:                                 if (e.key === "Enter")
578:                                   handleSaveLessonTitle(module.id, lesson.id);
579:                                 if (e.key === "Escape")
580:                                   setEditingLessonId(null);
581:                               }}
582:                               autoFocus
583:                               className="h-7 text-xs"
584:                             />
585:                             <button
586:                               type="button"
587:                               onClick={() =>
588:                                 handleSaveLessonTitle(module.id, lesson.id)
589:                               }
590:                               className="bg-primary text-primary-foreground flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded"
591:                             >
592:                               <Check className="size-3.5" />
593:                             </button>
594:                             <button
595:                               type="button"
596:                               onClick={() => setEditingLessonId(null)}
597:                               className="border-input text-muted-foreground flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded border"
598:                             >
599:                               <X className="size-3.5" />
600:                             </button>
601:                           </div>
602:                         ) : (
603:                           <div className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2">
604:                             <span className="text-foreground text-xs font-medium">
605:                               {lesson.title}
606:                             </span>
607:                             {!isPublished && !isArchived && (
608:                               <button
609:                                 type="button"
610:                                 aria-label={`Rename lesson ${lesson.title}`}
611:                                 onClick={() => {
612:                                   setEditingLessonId(lesson.id);
613:                                   setEditingLessonTitle(lesson.title);
614:                                 }}
615:                                 className="text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex size-6 items-center justify-center rounded"
616:                               >
617:                                 <Edit2 className="size-3" />
618:                               </button>
619:                             )}
620:                           </div>
621:                         )}
622:                       </div>
623:                       {}
624:                       <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
625:                         {}
````

## File: src/components/features/instructor/publish-button.tsx
````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import * as React from "react";
  3: import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
  4: import { CourseStatus } from "@prisma/client";
  5: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
  6: import { publishCourseAction, unpublishCourseAction } from "@/actions/course";
  7: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
  8: import { Globe, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
  9: interface PublishButtonProps {
 10:   courseId: string;
 11:   status: CourseStatus;
 12:   moduleCount: number;
 13:   lessonCount: number;
 14: }
 15: export function PublishButton({
 16:   courseId,
 17:   status,
 18:   moduleCount,
 19:   lessonCount,
 20: }: PublishButtonProps) {
 21:   const router = useRouter();
 22:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = React.useState(false);
 23:   const isPublished = status === CourseStatus.PUBLISHED;
 24:   const isArchived = status === CourseStatus.ARCHIVED;
 25:   const handleTogglePublish = async () => {
 26:     if (isArchived) return;
 27:     if (!isPublished) {
 28:       if (moduleCount < 1 || lessonCount < 1) {
 29:         gooeyToast.error(
 30:           "A course must have at least one module and at least one lesson before publishing.",
 31:         );
 32:         return;
 33:       }
 34:       setIsLoading(true);
 35:       try {
 36:         const result = await publishCourseAction(courseId);
 37:         if (result.success) {
 38:           gooeyToast.success(
 39:             "Course published! It is now publicly visible in the catalog.",
 40:           );
 41:           router.refresh();
 42:         } else {
 43:           gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to publish course.");
 44:         }
 45:       } catch {
 46:         gooeyToast.error("Failed to publish course. Please try again.");
 47:       } finally {
 48:         setIsLoading(false);
 49:       }
 50:     } else {
 51:       const confirmed = window.confirm(
 52:         "Unpublishing this course will return it to DRAFT. New students will not be able to find or enroll in it. Do you want to continue?",
 53:       );
 54:       if (!confirmed) return;
 55:       setIsLoading(true);
 56:       try {
 57:         const result = await unpublishCourseAction(courseId);
 58:         if (result.success) {
 59:           gooeyToast.success("Course unpublished and returned to Draft.");
 60:           router.refresh();
 61:         } else {
 62:           gooeyToast.error(result.error || "Failed to unpublish course.");
 63:         }
 64:       } catch {
 65:         gooeyToast.error("Failed to unpublish course. Please try again.");
 66:       } finally {
 67:         setIsLoading(false);
 68:       }
 69:     }
 70:   };
 71:   if (isArchived) {
 72:     return (
 73:       <Button
 74:         variant="outline"
 75:         size="sm"
 76:         disabled
 77:         className="min-h-10 min-w-10 text-xs opacity-60"
 78:       >
 79:         Archived Course
 80:       </Button>
 81:     );
 82:   }
 83:   return (
 84:     <Button
 85:       variant={isPublished ? "outline" : "default"}
 86:       size="sm"
 87:       disabled={isLoading}
 88:       onClick={handleTogglePublish}
 89:       className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 font-medium transition-all active:scale-[0.98] ${
 90:         isPublished
 91:           ? "border-amber-500/30 text-amber-700 hover:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-400"
 92:           : "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-emerald-700"
 93:       }`}
 94:     >
 95:       {isLoading ? (
 96:         <Loader2 className="mr-2 size-4 animate-spin" />
 97:       ) : isPublished ? (
 98:         <Lock className="mr-2 size-4" />
 99:       ) : (
100:         <Globe className="mr-2 size-4" />
101:       )}
102:       {isPublished ? "Unpublish Course" : "Publish Course"}
103:     </Button>
104:   );
105: }
````

````typescript
 2: interface PlayerResourceItem {

 4:   url: string;
 5: }
 6: export interface PlayerResourcesProps {

 9: function isSafeUrl(rawUrl: string): boolean {
10:   try {
11:     const parsed = new URL(rawUrl);
12:     return parsed.protocol === "http:" || parsed.protocol === "https:";
13:   } catch {
14:     return false;
15:   }

17: export function PlayerResources({ resources }: PlayerResourcesProps) {
````

````typescript
  1: "use client";
  2: import { useState } from "react";
  3: import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
  4: import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
  5: import {
  6:   updateProfileSchema,
  7:   type UpdateProfileInput,
  8: } from "@/lib/validations/profile";
  9: import { updateProfileAction } from "@/actions/profile";
 10: import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
 11: import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
 12: import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
 13: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 14: import { Loader2, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from "lucide-react";
 15: interface ProfileFormProps {
 16:   initialData: {
 17:     name?: string | null;
 18:     headline?: string | null;
 19:     bio?: string | null;
 20:     website?: string | null;
 21:     avatarUrl?: string | null;
 22:   };
 23: }
 24: export function ProfileForm({ initialData }: ProfileFormProps) {
 25:   const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{
 26:     type: "success" | "error";
 27:     message: string;
 28:   } | null>(null);
 29:   const {
 30:     register,
 31:     handleSubmit,
 32:     formState: { errors, isSubmitting },
 33:   } = useForm<UpdateProfileInput>({
 34:     resolver: zodResolver(updateProfileSchema),
 35:     defaultValues: {
 36:       name: initialData.name ?? "",
 37:       headline: initialData.headline ?? "",
 38:       bio: initialData.bio ?? "",
 39:       website: initialData.website ?? "",
 40:       avatarUrl: initialData.avatarUrl ?? "",
 41:     },
 42:   });
 43:   const onSubmit = async (data: UpdateProfileInput) => {
 44:     setFeedback(null);
 45:     try {
 46:       const result = await updateProfileAction(data);
 47:       if (result.success) {
 48:         setFeedback({
 49:           type: "success",
 50:           message: "Profile updated successfully.",
 51:         });
 52:       } else {
 53:         setFeedback({
 54:           type: "error",
 55:           message: result.error || "Failed to update profile.",
 56:         });
 57:       }
 58:     } catch {
 59:       setFeedback({
 60:         type: "error",
 61:         message: "An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.",
 62:       });
 63:     }
 64:   };
 65:   return (
 66:     <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)} className="space-y-6">
 67:       {feedback && (
 68:         <div
 69:           role="alert"
 70:           className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg p-3.5 text-sm ${
 71:             feedback.type === "success"
 72:               ? "border border-emerald-500/20 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
 73:               : "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border-destructive/20 border"
 74:           }`}
 75:         >
 76:           {feedback.type === "success" ? (
 77:             <CheckCircle2 className="size-4 shrink-0" />
 78:           ) : (
 79:             <AlertCircle className="size-4 shrink-0" />
 80:           )}
 81:           <span>{feedback.message}</span>
 82:         </div>
 83:       )}
 84:       <div className="space-y-2">
 85:         <Label htmlFor="name" className="text-sm font-medium">
 86:           Full Name
 87:         </Label>
 88:         <Input
 89:           id="name"
 90:           placeholder="Enter your name"
 91:           aria-invalid={!!errors.name}
 92:           className="min-h-10"
 93:           {...register("name")}
 94:         />
````

````typescript
 3: export interface CourseProgressBarProps {

12:   totalLessons,
13:   completedLessons,

15:   className,
16: }: CourseProgressBarProps) {

27:             </span>

30:             {clampedPercentage}% Complete

32:         </div>
33:       </div>
34:       {}
35:       <div
36:         role="progressbar"
37:         aria-valuenow={clampedPercentage}
38:         aria-valuemin={0}
39:         aria-valuemax={100}
40:         aria-label="Course completion progress"
41:         className="bg-muted h-2.5 w-full overflow-hidden rounded-full shadow-inner"

45:             isComplete

47:               : "bg-primary"
48:           }`}
49:           style={{ width: `${clampedPercentage}%` }}
50:         />
51:       </div>
52:       {}
53:       {isComplete && showCelebration && (

55:           role="status"
````

## File: src/components/features/progress/lesson-completion-button.tsx
````typescript
 1: "use client";
 2: import { useState } from "react";
 3: import { toggleLessonCompletionAction } from "@/actions/progress";
 4: import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
 5: import { Check, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
 6: import { gooeyToast } from "@/components/ui/goey-toaster";
 7: export interface LessonCompletionButtonProps {
 8:   lessonId: string;
 9:   initialIsCompleted?: boolean;
10:   onToggleSuccess?: (completed: boolean) => void;
11:   className?: string;
12: }
13: export function LessonCompletionButton({
14:   lessonId,
15:   initialIsCompleted = false,
16:   onToggleSuccess,
17:   className,
18: }: LessonCompletionButtonProps) {
19:   const [prevInitial, setPrevInitial] = useState(initialIsCompleted);
20:   const [isCompleted, setIsCompleted] = useState(initialIsCompleted);
21:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
22:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
23:   if (prevInitial !== initialIsCompleted) {
24:     setPrevInitial(initialIsCompleted);
25:     setIsCompleted(initialIsCompleted);
26:   }
27:   const handleToggle = async () => {
28:     if (isLoading) return;
29:     const nextState = !isCompleted;
30:     setIsLoading(true);
31:     setError(null);
32:     try {
33:       const result = await toggleLessonCompletionAction({
34:         lessonId,
35:         completed: nextState,
36:       });
37:       if (!result.success) {
38:         setError(result.error);
39:         gooeyToast.error(result.error);
40:         return;
41:       }
42:       setIsCompleted(result.data.progress.isCompleted);
43:       if (result.data.progress.isCompleted) {
44:         if (result.data.percentage === 100) {
45:           gooeyToast.success("Course 100% Completed! Congratulations! 🎉");
46:         } else {
47:           gooeyToast.success("Lesson marked as complete!");
48:         }
49:       } else {
50:         gooeyToast.info("Lesson marked as incomplete");
51:       }
52:       onToggleSuccess?.(result.data.progress.isCompleted);
53:     } catch {
54:       const message = "Failed to update lesson completion. Please try again.";
55:       setError(message);
56:       gooeyToast.error(message);
57:     } finally {
58:       setIsLoading(false);
59:     }
60:   };
61:   return (
62:     <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
63:       <Button
64:         type="button"
65:         onClick={handleToggle}
66:         disabled={isLoading}
67:         variant={isCompleted ? "outline" : "default"}
68:         className={`min-h-10 min-w-10 gap-2 transition-transform active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transform-none ${
69:           isCompleted
70:             ? "border-emerald-600/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-500/15 hover:text-emerald-800 dark:border-emerald-500/30 dark:bg-emerald-500/10 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:hover:bg-emerald-500/20"
71:             : ""
72:         } ${className ?? ""}`}
73:         aria-pressed={isCompleted}
74:         aria-label={
75:           isCompleted ? "Mark lesson incomplete" : "Mark lesson complete"
76:         }
77:       >
78:         {isLoading ? (
79:           <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
80:         ) : isCompleted ? (
81:           <Check
82:             className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400"
83:             aria-hidden="true"
84:           />
85:         ) : null}
86:         <span>{isCompleted ? "Completed" : "Mark as Complete"}</span>
87:       </Button>
88:       {error && (
89:         <p className="text-destructive text-xs" role="alert">
90:           {error}
91:         </p>
92:       )}
93:     </div>
94:   );
95: }
````

````typescript
  1: import sanitizeHtml from "sanitize-html";
  2: import { marked } from "marked";
  3: const ALLOWED_IFRAME_HOSTNAMES = new Set([
  4:   "youtube.com",
  5:   "www.youtube.com",
  6:   "player.vimeo.com",
  7:   "vimeo.com",
  8:   "loom.com",
  9:   "www.loom.com",
 10: ]);
 11: export const SANITIZER_CONFIG: sanitizeHtml.IOptions = {
 12:   allowedTags: [
 13:     "h1",
 14:     "h2",
 15:     "h3",
 16:     "h4",
 17:     "h5",
 18:     "h6",
 19:     "p",
 20:     "blockquote",
 21:     "pre",
 22:     "code",
 23:     "ul",
 24:     "ol",
 25:     "li",
 26:     "b",
 27:     "i",
 28:     "strong",
 29:     "em",
 30:     "strike",
 31:     "del",
 32:     "hr",
 33:     "table",
 34:     "thead",
 35:     "tbody",
 36:     "tr",
 37:     "th",
 38:     "td",
 39:     "a",
 40:     "img",
 41:     "iframe",
 42:   ],
 43:   allowedAttributes: {
 44:     a: ["href", "name", "target", "rel", "title"],
 45:     img: ["src", "alt", "title", "width", "height"],
 46:     iframe: ["src", "width", "height", "allowfullscreen", "frameborder"],
 47:     code: ["class"],
 48:     pre: ["class"],
 49:     th: ["align"],
 50:     td: ["align"],
 51:   },
 52:   allowedSchemes: ["http", "https", "mailto"],
 53:   allowedSchemesByTag: {
 54:     iframe: ["https"],
 55:     img: ["http", "https"],
 56:   },
 57:   transformTags: {
 58:     a: sanitizeHtml.simpleTransform("a", {
 59:       target: "_blank",
 60:       rel: "noopener noreferrer",
 61:     }),
 62:   },
 63:   exclusiveFilter: (frame) => {
 64:     if (frame.tag === "iframe") {
 65:       const src = frame.attribs.src;
 66:       if (!src) return true;
 67:       try {
 68:         const parsed = new URL(src);
 69:         if (parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
 70:           return true;
 71:         }
 72:         const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();
 73:         if (!ALLOWED_IFRAME_HOSTNAMES.has(hostname)) {
 74:           return true;
 75:         }
 76:       } catch {
 77:         return true;
 78:       }
 79:     }
 80:     if (frame.tag === "img") {
 81:       const src = frame.attribs.src;
 82:       if (!src) return true;
 83:       try {
 84:         const parsed = new URL(src);
 85:         if (parsed.protocol !== "http:" && parsed.protocol !== "https:") {
 86:           return true;
 87:         }
 88:       } catch {
 89:         return true;
 90:       }
 91:     }
 92:     return false;
 93:   },
 94: };
 95: export async function markdownToSanitizedHtml(
 96:   markdown: string,
 97: ): Promise<string> {
 98:   if (!markdown?.trim()) {
 99:     return "";
100:   }
101:   const rawHtml = await marked.parse(markdown, {
102:     gfm: true,
103:     breaks: true,
104:   });
105:   const cleanHtml = sanitizeHtml(rawHtml, SANITIZER_CONFIG);
106:   return cleanHtml;
107: }
````

````typescript
 30: export async function createCourseWithSlugRetry(
 31:   data: CreateCourseData,
 32:   baseSlug: string,
 33:   maxAttempts = 5,
 34: ): Promise<Course> {
 35:   for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= maxAttempts; attempt++) {
 36:     const candidateSlug = attempt === 1 ? baseSlug : `${baseSlug}-${attempt}`;
 37:     try {
 38:       return await prisma.course.create({
 39:         data: {
 40:           title: data.title,
 41:           slug: candidateSlug,
 42:           description: data.description,
 43:           level: data.level ?? CourseLevel.ALL_LEVELS,
 44:           category: data.category,
 45:           thumbnailUrl: data.thumbnailUrl,
 46:           status: CourseStatus.DRAFT,
 47:           instructorId: data.instructorId,
 48:         },
 49:       });
 50:     } catch (error) {
 51:       if (
 52:         error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError &&
 53:         error.code === "P2002"
 54:       ) {
 55:         if (attempt === maxAttempts) {
 56:           throw new ConflictError(
 57:             "Failed to generate a unique course slug. Please choose a different title.",
 58:           );
 59:         }
 60:         continue;
 61:       }
 62:       throw error;
 63:     }
 64:   }
 65:   throw new ConflictError("Failed to generate a unique course slug");

263: export interface InstructorCourseRow extends Course {
264:   _count: {
265:     modules: number;
266:     enrollments: number;
267:   };
268:   totalLessons: number;
269: }
270: export async function findCoursesByInstructorId(
271:   instructorId: string,
272: ): Promise<InstructorCourseRow[]> {
273:   const rawCourses = await prisma.course.findMany({
274:     where: { instructorId },
275:     orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
276:     include: {
277:       _count: {
278:         select: {
279:           modules: true,
280:           enrollments: true,
281:         },
282:       },
283:     },
284:   });
285:   const courseIds = rawCourses.map((c) => c.id);
286:   const lessonCountsByCourse = new Map<string, number>();
287:   if (courseIds.length > 0) {
288:     const modules = await prisma.module.findMany({
289:       where: { courseId: { in: courseIds } },
290:       select: {
291:         courseId: true,
292:         _count: {
293:           select: { lessons: true },
294:         },
295:       },
296:     });
297:     for (const mod of modules) {
298:       const current = lessonCountsByCourse.get(mod.courseId) ?? 0;
299:       lessonCountsByCourse.set(mod.courseId, current + mod._count.lessons);
300:     }
301:   }
302:   return rawCourses.map((c) => ({
303:     ...c,
304:     totalLessons: lessonCountsByCourse.get(c.id) ?? 0,
305:   }));
306: }

310:     orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
311:   });

313: export interface CourseCatalogQueryOptions {
314:   search?: string;
315:   category?: string;
316:   level?: CourseLevel;
317:   sort?: "newest" | "title_asc" | "title_desc";
318:   page?: number;
319:   limit?: number;
320: }
321: export interface CatalogCourseRow extends Course {
322:   instructor: {
323:     id: string;
324:     name: string | null;
325:     image: string | null;
326:     avatarUrl: string | null;
327:   };
328:   _count: {
329:     modules: number;
330:     enrollments: number;
331:   };
332:   totalLessons: number;
333: }
334: export interface PaginatedCoursesResult {
335:   courses: CatalogCourseRow[];
336:   totalCount: number;
337:   page: number;
338:   limit: number;
339:   totalPages: number;
340: }
341: export async function findPublishedCoursesPaginated(
342:   options: CourseCatalogQueryOptions,
343: ): Promise<PaginatedCoursesResult> {
344:   const page = Math.max(1, options.page ?? 1);
345:   const limit = Math.min(50, Math.max(1, options.limit ?? 12));
346:   const skip = (page - 1) * limit;
347:   const where: Prisma.CourseWhereInput = {
348:     status: CourseStatus.PUBLISHED,
349:   };
350:   if (options.level) {
351:     where.level = options.level;
352:   }
353:   if (options.category?.trim()) {
354:     where.category = options.category.trim();
355:   }
356:   if (options.search?.trim()) {
357:     const term = options.search.trim();
358:     where.OR = [
359:       { title: { contains: term, mode: "insensitive" } },
360:       { description: { contains: term, mode: "insensitive" } },
361:     ];
362:   }
363:   let orderBy: Prisma.CourseOrderByWithRelationInput;
364:   switch (options.sort) {
365:     case "title_asc":
366:       orderBy = { title: "asc" };
367:       break;
368:     case "title_desc":
369:       orderBy = { title: "desc" };
370:       break;
371:     default:
372:       orderBy = { createdAt: "desc" };
373:       break;
374:   }
375:   const [rawCourses, totalCount] = await Promise.all([
376:     prisma.course.findMany({
377:       where,
378:       orderBy,
379:       skip,
380:       take: limit,
381:       include: {
382:         instructor: {
383:           select: {
384:             id: true,
385:             name: true,
386:             image: true,
387:             avatarUrl: true,
388:           },
389:         },
390:         _count: {
391:           select: {
392:             modules: true,
393:             enrollments: true,
394:           },
395:         },
396:       },
397:     }),
398:     prisma.course.count({ where }),
399:   ]);
400:   const courseIds = rawCourses.map((c) => c.id);
401:   const lessonCountsByCourse = new Map<string, number>();
402:   if (courseIds.length > 0) {
403:     const modules = await prisma.module.findMany({
404:       where: { courseId: { in: courseIds } },
405:       select: {
406:         courseId: true,
407:         _count: {
408:           select: { lessons: true },
409:         },
410:       },
411:     });
412:     for (const mod of modules) {
413:       const current = lessonCountsByCourse.get(mod.courseId) ?? 0;
414:       lessonCountsByCourse.set(mod.courseId, current + mod._count.lessons);
415:     }
416:   }
417:   const courses: CatalogCourseRow[] = rawCourses.map((c) => ({
418:     ...c,
419:     totalLessons: lessonCountsByCourse.get(c.id) ?? 0,
420:   }));
421:   const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalCount / limit) || 1;
422:   return {
423:     courses,
424:     totalCount,
425:     page,
426:     limit,
427:     totalPages,
428:   };
429: }
430: export async function findPublishedCourseCategories(): Promise<string[]> {
431:   const results = await prisma.course.findMany({
432:     where: {
433:       status: CourseStatus.PUBLISHED,
434:       category: { not: null },
435:     },
436:     select: {
437:       category: true,
438:     },
439:     distinct: ["category"],
440:     orderBy: {
441:       category: "asc",
442:     },
443:   });
444:   return results
445:     .map((r) => r.category)
446:     .filter((cat): cat is string => Boolean(cat?.trim()));
447: }

457: export async function deleteCourseAtomic(courseId: string): Promise<Course> {
458:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
459:     await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, courseId);
460:     return tx.course.delete({
461:       where: { id: courseId },
462:     });
463:   });
464: }
465: export async function countCurriculumItems(
466:   courseId: string,
467:   tx?: Prisma.TransactionClient,
468: ): Promise<{ moduleCount: number; lessonCount: number }> {
469:   const client = tx ?? prisma;
470:   const moduleCount = await client.module.count({
471:     where: { courseId },
472:   });
473:   const lessonCount = await client.lesson.count({
474:     where: {
475:       module: { courseId },
476:     },
477:   });
478:   return { moduleCount, lessonCount };
479: }
480: export async function executeCourseStatusTransition(
481:   courseId: string,
482:   fromStatuses: CourseStatus[],
483:   toStatus: CourseStatus,
484:   validator?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<void>,
485: ): Promise<Course> {
486:   return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
487:     const course = await lockCourseForUpdate(tx, courseId);
488:     if (!fromStatuses.includes(course.status)) {
489:       throw new ValidationError(
490:         `Cannot transition course from ${course.status} to ${toStatus}`,
491:       );
492:     }
493:     if (validator) {
494:       await validator(tx);
495:     }
496:     return tx.course.update({
497:       where: { id: courseId },
498:       data: { status: toStatus },
499:     });
500:   });
501: }
````

````typescript
  1: import { CourseStatus } from "@prisma/client";

  3: class AsyncLock {

  5:   private locked = false;
  6:   async acquire(): Promise<() => void> {
  7:     if (!this.locked) {
  8:       this.locked = true;
  9:       return () => this.release();

 12:       this.queue.push(() => {

 15:       });
 16:     });
 17:   }
 18:   private release() {
 19:     const next = this.queue.shift();

 22:     } else {
 23:       this.locked = false;
 24:     }
 25:   }
 26: }
````

## File: src/services/authorization.ts
````typescript
  1: import { cache } from "react";
  2: import * as userRepository from "@/repositories/user";
  3: import * as userRoleRepository from "@/repositories/user-role";
  4: import * as roleRepository from "@/repositories/role";
  5: import { AuthorizationError, NotFoundError } from "@/lib/errors";
  6: export const getUserPermissions = cache(
  7:   async (userId: string): Promise<string[]> => {
  8:     const user = await userRepository.findUserWithRoles(userId);
  9:     if (!user) {
 10:       throw new NotFoundError("User not found");
 11:     }
 12:     const permissions = new Set<string>();
 13:     for (const userRole of user.userRoles) {
 14:       for (const rolePermission of userRole.role.rolePermissions) {
 15:         permissions.add(rolePermission.permission.name);
 16:       }
 17:     }
 18:     return Array.from(permissions);
 19:   },
 20: );
 21: export const getUserRoles = cache(async (userId: string) => {
 22:   const userRoles = await userRoleRepository.findUserRoles(userId);
 23:   return userRoles.map((ur) => ur.role);
 24: });
 25: export async function hasPermission(
 26:   userId: string,
 27:   permissionName: string,
 28: ): Promise<boolean> {
 29:   const permissions = await getUserPermissions(userId);
 30:   return permissions.includes(permissionName);
 31: }
 32: export async function hasAnyPermission(
 33:   userId: string,
 34:   permissionNames: string[],
 35: ): Promise<boolean> {
 36:   const permissions = await getUserPermissions(userId);
 37:   return permissionNames.some((name) => permissions.includes(name));
 38: }
 39: export async function hasAllPermissions(
 40:   userId: string,
 41:   permissionNames: string[],
 42: ): Promise<boolean> {
 43:   const permissions = await getUserPermissions(userId);
 44:   return permissionNames.every((name) => permissions.includes(name));
 45: }
 46: export async function hasRole(
 47:   userId: string,
 48:   roleName: string,
 49: ): Promise<boolean> {
 50:   const roles = await getUserRoles(userId);
 51:   return roles.some((role) => role.name === roleName);
 52: }
 53: export async function hasAnyRole(
 54:   userId: string,
 55:   roleNames: string[],
 56: ): Promise<boolean> {
 57:   const roles = await getUserRoles(userId);
 58:   return roles.some((role) => roleNames.includes(role.name));
 59: }
 60: export async function requirePermission(
 61:   userId: string,
 62:   permissionName: string,
 63: ) {
 64:   const allowed = await hasPermission(userId, permissionName);
 65:   if (!allowed) {
 66:     throw new AuthorizationError(
 67:       `Missing required permission: ${permissionName}`,
 68:     );
 69:   }
 70: }
 71: export async function requireAnyPermission(
 72:   userId: string,
 73:   permissionNames: string[],
 74: ) {
 75:   const allowed = await hasAnyPermission(userId, permissionNames);
 76:   if (!allowed) {
 77:     throw new AuthorizationError(
 78:       `Missing required permissions: ${permissionNames.join(", ")}`,
 79:     );
 80:   }
 81: }
 82: export async function requireAllPermissions(
 83:   userId: string,
 84:   permissionNames: string[],
 85: ) {
 86:   const allowed = await hasAllPermissions(userId, permissionNames);
 87:   if (!allowed) {
 88:     throw new AuthorizationError(
 89:       `Missing required permissions: ${permissionNames.join(", ")}`,
 90:     );
 91:   }
 92: }
 93: export async function requireRole(userId: string, roleName: string) {
 94:   const allowed = await hasRole(userId, roleName);
 95:   if (!allowed) {
 96:     throw new AuthorizationError(`Missing required role: ${roleName}`);
 97:   }
 98: }
 99: export async function requireAnyRole(userId: string, roleNames: string[]) {
100:   const allowed = await hasAnyRole(userId, roleNames);
101:   if (!allowed) {
102:     throw new AuthorizationError(
103:       `Missing required role: one of [${roleNames.join(", ")}] is required`,
104:     );
105:   }
106: }
107: export async function assignRole(userId: string, roleId: string) {
108:   const existing = await userRoleRepository.findUserRole(userId, roleId);
109:   if (existing) {
110:     return existing;
111:   }
112:   return userRoleRepository.assignRoleToUser(userId, roleId);
113: }
114: export async function removeRole(userId: string, roleId: string) {
115:   const existing = await userRoleRepository.findUserRole(userId, roleId);
116:   if (!existing) {
117:     throw new NotFoundError("Role assignment not found");
118:   }
119:   return userRoleRepository.removeRoleFromUser(userId, roleId);
120: }
121: export async function assignRoleToUserByName(
122:   actorUserId: string,
123:   targetUserId: string,
124:   roleName: string,
125: ) {
126:   await requireRole(actorUserId, "admin");
127:   const role = await roleRepository.findRoleByName(roleName);
128:   if (!role) {
129:     throw new NotFoundError(`Role not found: ${roleName}`);
130:   }
131:   return assignRole(targetUserId, role.id);
132: }
133: export async function removeRoleFromUserByName(
134:   actorUserId: string,
135:   targetUserId: string,
136:   roleName: string,
137: ) {
138:   await requireRole(actorUserId, "admin");
139:   const role = await roleRepository.findRoleByName(roleName);
140:   if (!role) {
141:     throw new NotFoundError(`Role not found: ${roleName}`);
142:   }
143:   return removeRole(targetUserId, role.id);
144: }
145: export async function assignInitialUserRole(
146:   userId: string,
147:   roleName: "student" | "instructor",
148: ) {
149:   const role = await roleRepository.findRoleByName(roleName);
150:   if (!role) {
151:     throw new NotFoundError(`Role not found: ${roleName}`);
152:   }
153:   return assignRole(userId, role.id);
154: }
````
